lines.vo: The average holiday weight gain is less than one pound.
That's not the scary part. The scary part is that it tends to stay.
So Dre keeps two short workouts a week in his Fit and Strong Tracker, even on Thanksgiving week.
lines.cap: So Dre keeps two short workouts a week in his Fit & Strong Tracker, even on Thanksgiving week.

lines.vo: One study weighed about two hundred adults before and after the holidays.
On average, they gained about zero point eight pounds.
lines.cap: On average, they gained about 0.8 pounds.

lines.vo: A year later, most of it still hadn't come off, so small gains can quietly stack up.
So don't aim for a perfect December. Just aim for not stopping.
Two workouts a week, logged. That's how you stay on track.

hook: Holiday weight gain is *smaller* than you think
